thread:
Anna (CS): Heads up 1h ago we got a report from Acme support: after their IdP rotated a service principal, their newly provisioned svc account key started failing for embeddings and rerank calls (403). Generation still works.

Anna (CS): Customer error excerpt:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk_svc_...
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope", "missing_scopes": ["embeddings", "rerank"]}
```

Priya (SRE): Can you repro in staging with their tenant and the rotated key? Do we know if it was created via the /provision SSO flow or Console manual key?

Anna (CS): It was provisioned via the SSO provisioner (`/internal/provision`) right after the IdP rotation. I reproduced in staging with their tenant id and the same provisioned key: `/generate` -> 200, `/embeddings` -> 403 with same payload.

Jasper (Eng - Identity): Pinged. Please attach the token introspection from the repro so I can inspect claim mapping.

Priya (SRE): Introspect logs from staging repro:
```
[authz] introspect: token=svc-zz9
[authz] raw_claims: {"sub":"svc-acme", "scp":"generation,embeddings,rerank"}
[authz] mapped_scopes: ["generation,embeddings,rerank"]  <-- single token retained
[authz] required: ["embeddings","rerank"] -> deny
```

Priya (SRE): Looks like the provisioner stored `mapped_scopes` as a single string token (commas included) instead of splitting into separate scope tokens. That causes exact-match checks to fail for `embeddings` and `rerank`.

Jasper (Eng - Identity): Root cause found: our SSO mapper reads the IdP scope claim `scp`. It handles two formats: an array (e.g. ["generation","embeddings"]) and a space-separated string ("generation embeddings"). But one IdP sends CSV (comma-separated) which we didn't parse. The current parser does `if string -> split(/\s+/)` which keeps the whole CSV as one token.

Jasper (Eng - Identity): Repro payload that triggers bug:
```
{"sub":"svc-acme","scp":"generation,embeddings,rerank"}
```

Jasper (Eng - Identity): Plan: push hotfix to provisioner to accept CSV, space-separated, or arrays; add unit tests; and emit telemetry when input format is unexpected. I'll stage the patch in 15m.

Priya (SRE): Short-term mitigation options for affected customers?

Jasper (Eng - Identity): Workarounds:
- Re-create the key using Console manual key creation (bypasses the SSO provisioner).
- Use an org-level API key (if allowed) which already carries the full scope set.
- We can run an internal admin patch to split the stored scope string and update token records for the tenant (manual hotfix).

OpsAdmin (EngOps): I can run a manual patch for high-severity customers. Command we used in staging (internal only):
```
POST /internal/admin/keys/patch
Body: {"key_id":"svc-zz9", "scopes":"generation,embeddings,rerank"}
-- admin tool will normalize CSV -> ["generation","embeddings","rerank"]
```

Anna (CS): Customer asked for manual fix. Please apply to `svc-zz9` for tenant `acme-corp` and confirm. Also please provide a curl snippet for them to validate after we fix it.

Priya (SRE): Manual patch applied for acme-corp in staging and prod override requested. After override acme reported embeddings calls succeeded.

Maya (SupportBot): Ticket CS-5890 created and escalated to identity. ETA for initial triage: 30m. CS-5890 updated: manual override performed, customer validated embedding/rerank success.

Jasper (Eng - Identity): Hotfix deployed to staging -> verified parsing now accepts CSV and arrays. Rolling to prod in the next deploy window (ETA 20m). Added unit tests for: CSV scp, space-separated scp, array scp, missing scp. Also added `provisioner.invalid_scp_format` metric.

Priya (SRE): Post-deploy verification steps: repro with fresh provisioned key, introspect token -> verify mapped_scopes is array, call /embeddings and /rerank -> 200.

Anna (CS): Customer confirms both embeddings and rerank working now in prod. They requested we add a clearer 400-level error message when we detect an unexpected `scp` format during provisioning (instead of silently storing an invalid scope).

Jasper (Eng - Identity): Will add validation that returns a user-facing error when provisioning detects an unsupported `scp` payload and instructions for IdP mapping. Also scheduling a backfill to correct any keys provisioned in last 72h.

Maya (SupportBot): CS-5890: hotfix deployed, manual overrides executed for affected tenants, backfill scheduled. Marked `customer-validated: true`.

Anna (CS): Thanks all. Closing CS loop once postmortem and the patch release note are in the ticket.
